The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/heb/copyright.htm):
> The Holy Bible in Modern Hebrew
> Public Domain
> Language: עברית (Hebrew)
> Translation by: Franz Delitzsch (1813–1890)
> 2022-06-14

What was found:
Text: the Masoretic consonant text and Franz Delitzsch's Hebrew New Testament (Delitzsch died 1890; Dalman, who edited later editions, died 1941).

Why it stays out: missing fact: the exact edition of Delitzsch's Hebrew New Testament (any edition by Delitzsch or Gustaf Dalman passes; a later revision by another person would not).

The read-aloud archive holds the Bible text chapter by chapter as plain text, a front file, the copyright page (copr.htm, left out of the source), and eBible.org's signing key (keys.asc, left out).

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=heb), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/heb/copyright.htm), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Franz_Delitzsch; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gustaf_Dalman.

held_out_by.note: eBible's chapter files, <code>_<NNN>_<BOOK>_<CC>_read.txt, are held out by book and chapter, so the same chapter is held out in every translation at once (maintainer's decision, 2026-10-23)
